verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in AI assistant inside Scribe that users can delegate tasks to. The closest item is an API parameter that applies a natural-language instruction to the final transcript and returns an edited_transcript. That is a single post-processing control, not an assistant, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The MCP server and agent-oriented realtime marketing concern other axes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
